title: Lower-limb MI dataset for knee pain patients from Zuo et al. 2025
description: EEG recordings from 30 knee pain patients performing a two-class lower-limb motor imagery task (left vs. right leg flexion/extension). Each participant completed 5 sessions of 100 cue-based trials, recorded with a 30-channel system at 500 Hz. The dataset supports brain-computer interface research for rehabilitation and benchmarking of classifiers such as CSP+LDA, FBCSP+SVM and EEGNet.
methods_description: 30-channel EEG was recorded with a ZhenTec EEG system at 500 Hz (reference CPz, ground FPz). Participants performed visually cued, offline 4-second motor imagery of left or right leg flexion/extension over 5 sessions of 100 trials (50 per class). Classification used CSP+LDA, FBCSP+SVM, EEGNet and OTFWRGD with 10-fold within-subject cross-validation.
